_comment: C3AE fixture manifest. Mirrors models/models/params.py logn16 profile (LogN16_D15_P6: 16 Q primes, 6 P primes — what the model itself needs). LoadOrionParams extends the chain by `ProtocolReserveLevels` 40-bit primes on top so MAC has level ≥ 1 headroom after the circuit's 15 rescales; this fixture intentionally reflects only the model-declared shape. `rotation_indices` are raw Orion k_orion values (the positive offsets Orion's evaluator calls RotateNew(ct, +k) with); LoadOrionParams negates them on ingest to fit the signed-label convention on protocol.Params. The list below is a representative subset — the real circuit declares hundreds of k_orion values.
